Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
Independent of the result of the E2E check a response message is sent to the client
(caller of the
Get()
() function). The message sent back to the client has message
type type
RESPONSE
and return code either (
OK
) or (
ERROR
).
This response message is E2E protected the same way as the
Get()
message as
described in chapters 7.4.1.2.4.1, 7.4.1.2.4.2 and 7.4.1.2.4.3.
